title: Catalog of General Ethical Requirements for AI Certification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark. It proposes a general ethical framework and mentions 'religious or philosophical beliefs' as a special category of personal data under GDPR that should be protected.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion, as it is a general ethical framework. It only mentions 'religious or philosophical beliefs' as an example of a sensitive data category protected under GDPR.
